text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Trainer!
I've thought long and hard about it,
and I definitely want to enter after all!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Is that not why you experienced a long-distance GⅠ at last year's Kikuka Sho!?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I am running.
Understood, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's go take them on!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ooh, someone who gets it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Partly due to No Reason's strong desire,
we decided to enter the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Let us go, Mira-ko, Sir Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: There is a deep~ reason why I set my sights on this race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so~?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: So there are times when there's actually a reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed, this time I am certain of it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Charge! Follow meee!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them ran out into the paddock.
And there, standing before them, was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm, mm, mmm...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, No Reason-chan?
Looking around so restlessly.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh... Just as I thought.
As expected, this race is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's an "Empty Fort"~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Akijiro...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Kris S is not here!
Neither is Tap!
Not a single formidable warlord is present!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In other words, an empty castle! The enemy is away!
That means we can run completely wild today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She's not home...
If that's the case, she really might run wild...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "If there are no strong girls around, that just means she can run freely without any pressure, right?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That is indeed the case.
You all should let loose and stretch your wings to your hearts' content—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Unleash the tempestuous soul within yourself!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A raging spirit...? Did I have something like that?
But still~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
3,200 meters might actually be manageable.
Even for someone who likes taking it easy like me,
I can somehow keep up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle's eyes were sparkling, which was a rare sight. It seemed she thought the race would suit her, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it looks like a fire has been lit within thee, Mirako.
Come at me, then!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're the main stars!
Let's clash swords and go at it
with everything we've got!
